name: Cloudflare Pages
description: Publish standalone page and design artifacts as Cloudflare Pages sites with public or email-restricted access, Web Analytics, version restore and agent publishing tools.

settings.label: Cloudflare API token
settings.description: Create a token with Cloudflare Pages: Edit, Account Settings: Edit and Account Analytics: Read.

settings.label: Cloudflare Access API token (optional)
settings.description: For Only people I choose: Access: Apps and Policies Write, plus Access: Organizations, Identity Providers, and Groups Read, with Zero Trust One-time PIN enabled.

capabilities.label: Cloudflare Pages sites
capabilities.description: List published sites, publish or update standalone page and design artifacts, inspect status and restore earlier versions.

tools.description: List up to 50 Cloudflare Pages sites of this workspace's artifacts for the connected account, optionally filtered by state.

Publish or update a standalone page or design artifact of this workspace on Cloudflare Pages. Idempotent: the same artifact keeps its address, access and readers. A new site may start public or restricted; changing an existing site's access or readers, removing a site and changing its address require the owner in Sites.

version.description: Artifact version number; defaults to the artifact's live version.

access.description: Who can open a new site; an existing site keeps its access (changing it is refused).

emails.description: Reader email addresses for a new restricted site; an existing site keeps its readers (changing them is refused).

analytics.description: Whether Cloudflare Web Analytics counts visits on this site.

projectName.description: Optional initial .pages.dev subdomain for a new site.

tools.description: Read compact publication and operation status for an artifact or operation ID.
Restore a previously published version of a site (rolls back on Cloudflare, or re-uploads the local immutable artifact version if Cloudflare pruned the deployment).

artifact.description: Artifact ID of the published site.

version.description: Previously published artifact version to restore.
